src.t: Spinal Cord Tracts: Ascending and Descending Pathways — Study Notes

qs.q: A patient with vitamin B12 deficiency develops bilateral numbness, tingling, and ataxia progressing to spastic weakness. Which spinal cord tracts are primarily affected?
o: Base of the pons and medullary pyramid fibers
Dorsal spinocerebellar tracts and ventral roots
Anterior spinothalamic and dorsal spinocerebellar tracts
Posterior columns and lateral corticospinal tracts
qs.e: Subacute combined degeneration involves the degeneration of both ascending posterior columns and descending lateral corticospinal tracts. Thiamine deficiency affects the mammillary bodies rather than primarily the spinal cord tracts.
